apps.name: Firefly Catch
apps.author: NightOS
apps.summary: Catch fireflies over a moonlit pond before the night ends.
apps.description: Tap or click to swing your net. Fireflies are worth points and build a combo; moths break it. You have sixty seconds, and your best score is remembered.

apps.name: Night Sketch
apps.author: NightOS
apps.summary: A glowing drawing pad with night-sky colors.
apps.description: Draw with soft glowing brushes on a dark canvas. Pick a color and size, undo strokes, and save your drawing as a PNG.

apps.name: Discord
apps.author: Discord
apps.summary: Chat, voice and video with your friends and servers.
apps.description: Opens the official Discord web app in a new browser tab, with your normal login, voice channels and screen sharing.

apps.name: Steam Store
apps.author: Valve
apps.description: Opens the Steam store in a new tab. Games themselves need the Steam app on a real computer or a cloud gaming service.

apps.name: YouTube
apps.author: Google
apps.description: Opens YouTube in a new browser tab.

apps.name: Spotify
apps.author: Spotify
apps.summary: Music and podcasts in the web player.
apps.description: Opens the Spotify web player in a new browser tab.

apps.name: Photopea
apps.author: Photopea
apps.summary: A full photo editor that runs in the browser.
apps.description: Opens Photopea in a new browser tab. It opens PSD, XCF, Sketch and common image files.

apps.name: Excalidraw
apps.author: Excalidraw
apps.description: Opens Excalidraw in a new browser tab.

apps.name: Wikipedia
apps.author: Wikimedia
apps.description: Opens Wikipedia in a new browser tab.

apps.name: GitHub
apps.author: GitHub
apps.summary: NightOS's source code and app submissions.
apps.description: Opens the NightOS repository on GitHub, where you can read the code or submit an app.
